resources.string: Images follow picker order. Contain preserves each complete image with padding; Cover crops to fill its cell. Grid uses two columns. Collage inputs are decoded to at most 1 million pixels each; the canvas is limited to 2,048 pixels per edge and 4 million pixels. Switching modes clears generated output but keeps selected sources, added single-image edits and size settings until you leave or recreate this screen. An unadded markup draft is discarded on mode switch.

Basic encoded-sRGB adjustments, not AI enhancement or color-managed correction. Zero leaves that adjustment unchanged. Applied to the generated image; inspect the final encoded preview before exporting.
Choose 2–4 images and check canvas dimensions, opaque background and adjustment bounds.
